effective_or_revised: Text says Policy MMP099.11, last committee approval June 11, 2025, effective September 1, 2026. Library metadata calls it MMP099.07 effective 09/01/2024; the PDF text differs, so treat the number as unreliable.

criteria_location: There are no criteria in the document. Coverage Rationale points to (a) the MAC LCDs/LCAs in a table, (b) InterQual CP: Phlebectomy for stab phlebectomy where no LCD exists, (c) the UHC commercial policy for MOCA where no LCD exists. All 4 pages are pointers.

Endomechanical ablation of incompetent extremity veins / MOCA / ClariVein (CPT 36473, 36474)

extraction_hazards: A multi-column table of NCD / LCD / LCA / Contractor with merged cells: the contractor name appears only on the last row of each group, and LCD/LCA pairs are separated by line wraps (L34209 has two LCAs).
Footnote asterisks (*, **) on contractor names carry state-level exceptions (Virginia counties) in a note below the second table.
Table split across pages with a repeated header on page 3, and a second 'Stab Phlebectomy' table with one row (WPS only).
Policy number in the text (MMP099.11) differs from the library metadata (MMP099.07); effective date is in the future relative to committee approval.
Hyperlinks ('Click here to view the InterQual criteria') are not in the extracted text.
interesting_structures: A routing document: decides which external document to read by member's state (MAC jurisdiction table), then by procedure.
Three-level fallback: NCD (none) -> LCD/LCA per MAC -> UHC commercial policy or InterQual.

Instructions for Use states the policy applies Medicare source materials first and 'Where there is a conflict between this document and Medicare source materials, the Medicare source materials apply.'

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: No criteria exist in the file. A checker could only produce a routing decision (which LCD applies for this member's state). For a Florida member the real criteria are First Coast LCD L38720, a different document that is not in this library.
